page.layout: One printed page with a wide text block, and a narrow strip at the far left that is the edge of the neighbouring page (not transcribed). Running head centred at the top, page number at top right. Text in one column. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines "Charitas n. Christi urget" and "fides illa Iesuitica".

main_text.p: dilectionem legis operatio. Quibus verbis Augustinus à transgressione nostra, qua excidimus à lege, circumducit nos quasi in circulo ad opera gratiæ, quæ sunt opera legis. Quod si quis obiiciat, opera legis à scholasticis intelligi, non quæ p fide, & dilectione fiunt, sed q-p[?] minas extorquet lex. Respondeo, scholasticorum speculationes hic non excutio, q nec opera gratiæ nec opera legis recte explicarunt. Nam opera p minas extorta quomodo opera legis dici possint non video; quandoquidem lex perfecta obedientiam postulat ex toto corde, tota anima, & tota mente. Minatur quidem lex non obedientibus poenas, sed obedientia extorta per minas non est legis obedientia. Deinde patrum sententia, q nos exquirimus, ab huiusmodi arguties longe remota est. Patres n. ita opera intelligunt, ut eadem sint opera, & à lege imperata, & à gratia impetrata, eadeq; à iustificatione omnino exclusa. Lex ex iustitia requirit hæc opera, fides a. ea præstat ex obedientia. Iustificatus n. quum semel misericordiam Dei in se agnouerit, ingratissimum se, atq; miserrimum omnium hominum iudicat, nisi p tanta infinita misericordia in bonis operibus, obedientiæ, & gratitudinis testimoniis exhibeat. Charitas n. Christi urget1.Cor.5.14. nos, æstimates hoc quoniam si vnus ꝓ omnibus mortuus est, ergo omnes mortui fuerunt. Et ꝓ omnibus mortuus est Christus, ut qui viuunt, iam non sibi viuant, sed ei, qui pro ipsis mortuus est & resurrexit, sicut docet Apostolus. Hæc est illa charitas, urges & constringes nos, qui iustificatos homines non patitur esse otiosos, sed ut semper bonis operibus studeant, mouet, imo commouet, coërcet, excitat. Itaq; fides illa IesuiticaBellarm. execranda sæpe in Eccl. Christi habita est, qua docet:lib. 1. de fidē iustif. c.15.

page.notes: The left-hand strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and was not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "q-p" after "sed" (marked [?]); "Patrum" and the italic summary line at the start were read as a marginal summary placed at the head of the paragraph. The note "lib. 1. de fidem iustif. c.15." was read as "fidē", since the abbreviation mark is unclear at this scan's resolution. The sentence after "Hæc est illa charitas" is set as printed. The paragraph continues onto the next page after "qua docet:".
